name: discovery-platform
description: Discovery Platform — an extensible discovery and lead-intelligence engine. Root workspace: install once, then build/test/typecheck every package from here.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/discovery-core && npm run build -w packages/discovery-db && npm run build -w packages/discovery-client && npm run build -w domains/vacancies && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/discovery-core && npm run build -w packages/discovery-db && npm run build -w packages/discovery-client && npm run build -w domains/vacancies && npm run build -w apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p packages/discovery-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/discovery-db/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/discovery-client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p domains/vacancies/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/discovery-core && npm run test -w packages/discovery-db && npm run test -w packages/discovery-client && npm run test -w domains/vacancies && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w examples/basic-discovery && npm run test -w examples/vacancy-discovery && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:examples: npm run test -w examples/basic-discovery && npm run test -w examples/vacancy-discovery
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w packages/discovery-db && node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/discovery-db/dist/migrate.js
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/discovery-core -w packages/discovery-db -w domains/vacancies && npm run build -w apps/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env apps/api/dist/server.js
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/discovery-client && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
